text.intro:
Entry fees paid in cash at the gate, and a scoreboard that nobody trusts.
Five riders are involved. Determine each rider's entry fee, event, animal and outcome.
- **Rider**: Travis Mundy, Dalton Reese, Cody Vance, Marla Hobbs and Buck Jessup.
- **Entry fee** (listed from cheaper to dearer): $2, $4, $6, $8 and $10.
- **Event**: tie-down roping, bareback, barrel racing, team roping and bull riding.
- **Stock drawn**: Tumbleweed, Widowmaker, Little Sister, Brimstone and Sunday Sermon.
- **Outcome**: a broken barrier, a no-score, a blown stirrup, a slap of the free hand and a clean ride.
Every rider has a different entry fee, event, animal and outcome, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: The rider who enters bareback pays $10. The rider who finishes with a no-score falls somewhere between $10 and the rider who draws Sunday Sermon in entry fee order.
Dalton Reese and $6 are exactly one fee step apart in entry fee order, in one direction or the other. Travis Mundy is exactly one fee step cheaper than $6, with no entry fee in between.
The rider who enters team roping is cheaper than $4 in entry fee order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) $6 is exactly one fee step cheaper than the rider who enters tie-down roping, with no entry fee in between. (b) Cody Vance enters tie-down roping.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The rider who finishes with a no-score is dearer than $6 in entry fee order. (b) The rider who finishes with a slap of the free hand is cheaper than the rider who draws Little Sister in entry fee order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The rider who finishes with a no-score is dearer than $6 in entry fee order. (b) The rider who finishes with a slap of the free hand pays $6.
Dalton Reese does not finish with a no-score.
The rider who finishes with a broken barrier is cheaper than the rider who draws Widowmaker in entry fee order.
Cody Vance and the rider who draws Tumbleweed are exactly one fee step apart in entry fee order, in one direction or the other.
The rider who draws Tumbleweed falls somewhere between the rider who finishes with a blown stirrup and the rider who finishes with a clean ride in entry fee order.
The rider who finishes with a slap of the free hand falls somewhere between Cody Vance and Marla Hobbs in entry fee order.
The rider who enters bull riding and the rider who draws Brimstone are exactly one fee step apart in entry fee order, in one direction or the other.
The rider who enters team roping is cheaper than the rider who finishes with a blown stirrup in entry fee order.
